creators.name: Dr Leslie Tay (ieatishootipost)
creators.followers: Award-winning Singapore food blog since 2006 + YouTube channel

attach.note: Dr Leslie Tay's write-up of Two Chefs' signature butter pork ribs — 'ooh so shiok' — establishing the dish's authority; the Sin Ming Ave branch is the Bishan outlet.
ieatishootipost featured the Midview City Thai zi char and its pad-thai-with-gravy on the Sin Ming Industrial Estate food trail.
ieatishootipost documented Joy's home-grown blue-pea mee hoon kueh as a Sin Ming food-trail hidden gem.

rejected.name: Palm Garden (Bishan Park cafe)
rejected.reason: Only one credible outlet found (Honeycombers); the rest are TripAdvisor / Lemon8 / aggregators. Held below the 2-credible bar.

rejected.name: Columbus Coffee Co. (Upper Thomson/Thomson Garden)
rejected.reason: By the Atlas Coffeehouse team but only Honeycombers credible; other coverage is personal blogs/aggregators, and it sits on the Thomson-Garden edge. Held.

rejected.name: Canopy — additional aggregator listings
rejected.reason: TripAdvisor / Yelp / Burpple used only to measure; Canopy itself cleared the bar on Honeycombers + HungryGoWhere.

rejected.name: Wei Ji Congee (150a Bishan St 11)
rejected.reason: Only Eatbook's Bishan guide found as a credible voice; no confirmable second. Held for a future wave.

rejected.name: Fu Hui Wantan Noodle & Lor Mee (Bishan St 11)
rejected.reason: Only the HungryGoWhere family feature found; no confirmable second credible source. Held.

rejected.name: Huat Heng Fried Prawn Mee (Shunfu Mart)
rejected.reason: On Eatbook's Shunfu 10-list but no confirmable second credible outlet. Held.

rejected.name: The Wholefood Kitchen (Bishan Cafeteria) — CLOSED
rejected.reason: Permanently closed and only aggregator/one-blog coverage; does not clear 2 credible even as a flagged-closed entry. Rejected.

rejected.name: Chi Western / 吃Western (One Pemimpin) — CLOSED
rejected.reason: Closed, and only Miss Tam Chiak found as a credible voice; below the 2-credible bar even flagged-closed. Rejected.

rejected.name: Wowffle Burger (Bishan) — CLOSED
rejected.reason: Closed; the only Eatbook/SethLui 'waffle burger' reviews are of a different cafe (Waffl, Jurong East). No credible Bishan coverage. Rejected.

rejected.name: J8 chain outlets (TamJai SamGor, Yakiniku Like, FIREYAKI, Mister Donut)
rejected.reason: Generic mall chains, not Bishan-unique hidden gems; excluded per the food-discovery editorial rule despite Eatbook mall round-up mentions.

rejected.name: Yelp / TripAdvisor / Google / OpenRice / Burpple / FoodAdvisor / Foursquare / Wanderlog / foodpanda / Chope / Klook
rejected.reason: User-review / booking / delivery aggregators — used only to MEASURE popularity or confirm addresses, never counted toward the 2-credible bar.

rejected.name: johorkaki / The Ranting Panda / Ordinary Patrons / thefooddossier / SG Food on Foot / live2makan / suchafatty / vegefoodhunt (as sole source)
rejected.reason: Personal food blogs without the editorial track record required; used for cross-checking only, not counted toward the credible bar on their own.

rejected.name: Lemon8 / anonymous TikTok discover pages / homejourney.sg / 365credit.sg / nearme.com.sg / islifearecipe.net / getgo.sg
rejected.reason: Affiliate/credit/real-estate blogs, SEO listicles or anonymous social pages — unverifiable authority; rejected.
